title: Reumsg
body:
**This is the first official stable release of Reumsg! I moved away from clunky commands to a much faster, "shorthand" system for managing join messages.**

✨ New Features
Simplified Commands: You no longer need to type id=1. Just use the number directly (e.g., /reumsg 1 ).

Numerical IDs: Added a check to make sure IDs are always numbers to prevent config breakages.

Live Preview: Use /reumsg preview to see exactly how your current join message looks in chat without having to relog.

Placeholder Support: Hardcoded %player% and %player_name% to work out-of-the-box, plus full PlaceholderAPI support.

Tag Cheat Sheet: Added /reumsg placeholders so you don't have to remember every MiniMessage tag.

🛠️ Technical Changes
Dynamic Versioning: The plugin now detects its own version for the startup log.

Colorful Console: Added a fancy Cyan/Blue ASCII logo when the plugin enables.

MiniMessage Integration: Full support for gradients, rainbows, and hex colors.

📦 Installation
Download the Reumsg-1.2.jar below.

Drop it into your server's plugins folder.

Restart or load the plugin and enjoy!
